title: ntfy and Gotify notifications
summary: Send playback and Jellyseerr request alerts to ntfy or Gotify. Configure either provider in .env, alongside the existing notification channels.
highlights: Use your own ntfy or Gotify server to receive alerts on your phone.
Connect with an ntfy access token or a Gotify application token. ntfy servers that allow publishing without authentication are also supported.
Both channels are optional and stay off until configured. The README includes setup examples and Docker configuration notes.
